name: Slack
description: Slack is a workplace communication platform built around channels, direct messages, integrations, and searchable conversations.
best_for: Positioned for teams and businesses across departments — engineering, sales, customer service, marketing, HR — looking to replace email-based workflows with organized, searchable communication.

alternatives.name: Microsoft Teams
alternatives.description: A communication and collaboration platform with chat, meetings, file sharing, and Microsoft 365 integration.

alternatives.name: Discord
alternatives.description: A community-focused communication platform with text channels, voice rooms, and real-time collaboration.

alternatives.name: Mattermost
alternatives.description: A team messaging platform designed for organizations that need greater control over hosting and security.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Messages are saved and searchable for 90 days; up to 10 apps.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: $7.25 per user per month when paying annually; $8.75 per user per month when paying monthly. The page shows a 50% discount for the first 3 months of an eligible upgrade.

tiers.name: Business+
tiers.notes: $15 per user per month when paying annually; $18 per user per month when paying monthly. The page shows a 50% discount for the first 3 months of an eligible upgrade.

cons: Free plan keeps messages saved and searchable for only 90 days, per its pricing page
Free plan is limited to up to 10 apps, per its pricing page
